Brand Guidelines
01 · Foundation

Brand at a Glance

LiLi M.D. is an intelligent operating layer for independent medical practices, the AI-native system that runs the business behind the practice, so doctors stay independent and the work simply gets done.

Personality
ConfidentialRefinedFounder-ledExclusiveBy invitation
Voice principles

We reason from first principles. We let the math decide. We disagree and commit. The tone is calm, plain, and certain, never loud.

Signature lines (examples, not mandates)

“We rise together.”  ·  “Independent, together.”

Visual & texture direction

The world the brand draws from, applied with restraint, never as literal decoration.

  • Tech, brushed-metal precision, the quiet sheen of copper on dark.
  • Florida coast, soft Gulf light, calm negative space, an unhurried horizon.
  • Medical, clinical clarity, order, nothing extraneous.

Favor space and material over imagery. When photography is used, it is sparse, warm-lit, and never stocky.

02 · Architecture

Naming & Entity Architecture

LiLi’s Game Inc is the studio. LiLi M.D. is the first company it built. The Private Club at LiLi MD is how member doctors experience it.

01
LiLi’s Game Inc
The studio & parent. Builds and runs the AI platform, then launches companies alongside experts. Co-brand line: “A LiLi’s Game Company.”
builds & runs
02
LiLi MD
The company doctors join. Legal entity LiLi MD Group Inc (Florida). Everything doctor-facing leads with LiLi M.D.
presented to members as
03
The Private Club at LiLi MD
The invitation-only membership experience, gated access, founding members, concierge care.
Naming rules
  • LiLi MD, in logo, design & UI. One space, no periods.
  • LiLi M.D., in running body text. With periods.
  • LiLi MD Group Inc, legal name, formal use only.
  • The Private Club at LiLi MD, written in full.
  • Add ™ where the marks appear.
  • No social media at this time, keep handles and icons off the site, portal, and documents.
Retired forms, never use
  • LiLiMD merged
  • LiLi Health off-brand
  • LiLi Solutions, Inc. old entity

Brand Guidelines
04 · Logo

Placement & Misuse

Clear space & minimum size

Keep clear space of at least x on every side, where x equals the width of one emblem bar. Minimum emblem size: 24px on screen, 10mm in print.

Placement

Anchor the logo top-left in document headers, aligned to the page margin. Give it room; let it sit alone.

Do not
Stretch or distort
Recolor
Rotate
Add effects
Low-contrast field
Busy background

Usage & contrast

Aubergine fills the field; copper stays an accent (roughly a tenth of any layout) and is never used for long body text. Cream on aubergine and aubergine on cream both clear AA for body. Copper on aubergine is reserved for large or accent type only.

The body-font rule

Branded & printed → Lora body.
Functional & digital → Poppins body.

Times New Roman is a fallback only, used when Lora cannot be installed or embedded (Poppins falls back to Calibri / Arial). Never Times New Roman by choice.

07 · Documents

Page Template & Anatomy

Every LiLi document is built on one structure. The structure, spacing, fonts and colors are locked, the words in the header tag and footer line are yours to set per document.

LiLi MD  ·  Running labelConfidential
Section, eyebrow
6. Section title
We rise together.9 / 16
  1. Header zones, lockup & running label left; context tag right (Confidential, a date, or empty).
  2. Divider, thin copper rule with the diamond ornament centered.
  3. Body recipe, in order, eyebrow → numbered title → body → optional panel or pull-quote.
  4. Footer zones, optional tagline or document title left; page number right.
  5. Confidentiality, mark sensitive documents in the header-right tag as needed.

Brand Guidelines
Reference

Quick Reference

Color
#37172F#CB9D83#FAF7F2
Type

Lora, headings & branded body. Poppins, labels, captions, digital body. TNR fallback only.

Naming

LiLi MD (logo/design) · LiLi M.D. (body) · LiLi MD Group Inc (legal) · The Private Club at LiLi MD · ™ · no social.

Five to remember
  • Do anchor the logo top-left with clear space.
  • Do keep copper to accents, words in cream or plum.
  • Don’t stretch, recolor, or rotate the mark.
  • Don’t merge as “LiLiMD”, use LiLi MD in design, LiLi M.D. in body.
  • Don’t set brand body copy in Times New Roman by choice.
Master files

Logo lockup, emblem, and reversed (white) emblem live in the brand asset library. Always place from masters, never rebuild.
